title: Reasoning-Trace Overflow in Code Generation: An Empirical Study of Explicit Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explicit reasoning can help language models generate code, but it also introduces a practical risk: the model may spend so much of its output budget reasoning that it never produces usable code. We study this behaviour in relatively small open-weight reasoning models, framing it as reasoning-trace overflow. Across seven models and six code benchmark settings, we measure how much of a fixed 32k-token output budget is spent on reasoning, whether that reasoning improves pass@1, and whether lightweight inference-time controls can mitigate overflow. Our results show that the value of reasoning is highly conditional. Overflow is rare on simpler function-level tasks, but becomes common on harder code-generation benchmarks and for particular model families: on several model--benchmark pairs, more than half of generations exhaust the full 32k-token budget while still reasoning. Most complete overflow is associated with repetitive reasoning loops,

translated_title: 代码生成中的推理轨迹溢出：显式推理模型的实证研究
translated_abstract: 显式推理可以帮助语言模型生成代码，但它也带来一个实际风险：模型可能将过多的输出预算用于推理，以致于永远无法生成可用的代码。我们在相对较小的开源权重推理模型中研究这一行为，并将其定义为“推理轨迹溢出”。我们在七个模型和六个代码基准测试设置下，测量了固定32k-token输出预算中有多少被用于推理、这种推理是否能提升pass@1，以及轻量级的推理时控制手段能否缓解溢出问题。我们的结果表明，推理的价值具有高度的条件性。在较简单的函数级任务上，溢出很少发生；但在更难的代码生成基准测试和特定模型家族中，溢出变得普遍：在若干“模型-基准”组合上，超过一半的生成耗尽了全部32k-token预算却仍在推理。大多数完全溢出与重复性的推理循环相关。
tldr: 该研究提出“推理轨迹溢出”概念，实证发现显式推理模型在较难的代码生成任务上常常将全部输出预算耗尽于推理而无法产出可用代码，而轻量级的推理时控制可以缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This empirical study identifies "reasoning-trace overflow," showing that explicit reasoning models on harder code-generation benchmarks often exhaust their entire output budget on reasoning without producing usable code, and that lightweight inference-time controls can mitigate this issue.
